items.title: Incorrect index logic in pick_slot
items.summary: Fix pick_slot to correctly use hour as 0-indexed per docstring.
test:
import sys, pathlib
sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from scheduler import pick_slot

slots = ['slot0', 'slot1', 'slot2']
assert pick_slot(slots, 0) == 'slot0'
